briefing: - 今日无KEV、无勒索标记，EPSS低且无PoC，勿夸大在野攻击。
- 批量出现9个CVSS 9.6漏洞，产品信息缺失，需立即补齐清单。
- 最优先处置CVSS 9.6批量项，并核查Drupal 9.1模板注入风险。
- 容器/虚拟化连续3个8.7认证缺陷，暴露面系统先排查。
- Microsoft邮件栈溢出7.5，受影响版本待补，暂列二级排查。

items.title: Ingress入口缺失认证可绕过访问控制
items.title_zh: Ingress入口缺失认证可绕过访问控制
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者经指定Ingress Host访问受保护后端，绕过认证且无日志
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级相关Ingress控制器至修复版本；临时禁用auth注解
items.repro_note: 构造Ingress Host直达受保护后端，需存在auth注解
items.impact_scope: 容器Ingress入口，常暴露公网
items.description: Traefik v3.7.13 before v3.7.14 contains an access-control bypass in the Kubernetes Ingress NGINX provider, where the HTTP router generated for ssl-passthrough Ingresses on non-TLS entry points never applies the Ingress's access-control annotations. Unauthenticated attackers reaching the HTTP entry point with the Ingress host can access backends protected by auth-type, auth-url, or whitelist-source-range annotations, with nothing logged.

items.title: Traefik认证绕过伪造客户端头
items.title_zh: Traefik认证绕过伪造客户端头
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可伪造Ssl-Client-*头，绕过K8s Ingress认证访问后端
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级到Traefik 3.7.14或更高版本
items.repro_note: 在明文HTTP路由发送伪造Ssl-Client-*头，需启用客户端认证
items.impact_scope: K8s入口代理，常暴露公网
items.description: Traefik from v3.7.0 before v3.7.14 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in its Kubernetes Ingress-NGINX provider that forwards client-supplied Ssl-Client-* headers on the plaintext HTTP router. When ssl-redirect is disabled alongside auth-tls-pass-certificate-to-upstream, unauthenticated attackers can send Ssl-Client-Verify: SUCCESS with a chosen certificate subject and issuer to impersonate mTLS identities.

items.title: Traefik客户端CA碰撞认证绕过
items.title_zh: Traefik客户端CA碰撞认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 持有其他主机CA证书的攻击者可绕过目标主机客户端CA认证访问
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级到Traefik 3.7.14或更高版本
items.repro_note: 需持有另一主机CA签发证书，构造同名auth-tls-secret
items.impact_scope: K8s Ingress入口，常暴露公网
items.description: Traefik v3.7.0 before v3.7.14 contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the Kubernetes Ingress NGINX provider that merges client CAs when auth-tls-secret names collide after dot-to-dash normalization. Attackers holding certificates from another host's CA can access a host requiring its own client CA, while that host's legitimate clients are refused.

Brotli 未授权 CWE-252
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.affected: Node.js(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream. Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

items.title: NT OneAPP 未授权 证书校验缺陷
items.description: NT OneAPP developed by NewType Infortech has an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability. Unauthenticated network-adjacent attackers can perform a man-in-the-middle attack by failing to validate the server certificate and the hostname, thereby intercepting or modifying communications between the application and the server.

items.title: YiShaAdmin 未授权 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: YiShaAdmin 2.2 through 3.1, fixed in commit 025b062, contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in the /admin/File/DownloadFile endpoint that allows attackers to read and delete arbitrary files via the filePath parameter. Attackers can send crafted GET requests with directory traversal sequences in filePath and set the delete parameter to read or remove system files like etc/passwd. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-20.

items.title: Magic Link 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: These settings can cause Magic Link verification records and OAuth state to resolve to the same stored identifier, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to start OAuth sign-in for a known email address and redeem the returned state through Magic Link without controlling the mailbox or completing the provider callback. The attacker can obtain a normal session for an existing user, or create an account incorrectly marked as email verified when sign-up is enabled.

items.summary_zh: 未授权网络攻击者可利用链接解析缺陷提升权限，影响Azure虚拟机

items.title_zh: Azure K8s配置服务缺失认证

items.action_zh: 应用Azure平台修复；最小化服务暴露面
items.repro_note: 需可访问Azure K8s配置服务入口，调用未鉴权功能
items.impact_scope: Azure云管面，常暴露服务入口
items.description: Missing authentication for critical function in Azure Kubernetes Configuration Service allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

items.title: 代理加密上下文复用致管理员凭证伪造
items.title_zh: 代理加密上下文复用致管理员凭证伪造
items.summary_zh: 已认证内部用户可让API密钥流程加密返回伪造管理员凭证，提升权限
items.action_zh: 升级代理至1.100.4/1.101.3等修复版本
items.repro_note: 需内部认证用户，经API密钥流程注入伪造元数据
items.impact_scope: 内部代理/密钥服务，需认证
items.description: From 1.87.0 until 1.100.4, 1.101.3, 1.102.2, 1.103.1, and 1.104.0-rc.2, the proxy reuses one cryptographic context for at-rest secrets and session tokens, allowing an authenticated internal user to have crafted metadata containing a forged administrator credential encrypted and returned by the API-key flow. Versions 1.87.0 through 1.90.x require EXPERIMENTAL_UI_LOGIN to be enabled, while versions after 1.91.0 are exploitable in the default configuration.

items.title: Incus备份卷名路径遍历可写主机文件
items.title_zh: Incus备份卷名路径遍历可写主机文件
items.summary_zh: 有实例创建权限者可导入恶意备份，经../卷名写入主机文件并完全控制
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级Incus至7.0.2/7.5.0或更高；审查备份
items.repro_note: 需实例创建权限，导入卷名含../的恶意实例备份
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚机管理面，可提权至宿主机
items.description: Incus 7.0.0 before 7.0.2 and 7.1.0 before 7.5.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows clients able to create instances to write files on the host. The flaw stems from unvalidated dependent custom volume names in instance backup index.yaml files. Attackers can import a crafted instance backup with ../ sequences in dependent volume names to create root-owned directories with controlled content, leading to full host compromise.

items.title: Incus迁移卷符号链接任意文件写入
items.title_zh: Incus迁移卷符号链接任意文件写入
items.summary_zh: 恶意迁移源可在传输卷中植入符号链接，以root写主机文件并接管
items.repro_note: 需控制迁移源，构造含rootfs符号链接的rsync或btrfs流
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚机管理面，可写宿主机
items.description: Incus before 6.0.7, 6.1.0 before 7.0.2, and 7.1.0 before 7.5.0 contains an arbitrary file write vulnerability that allows malicious migration sources to write host files by planting symlinks in transferred volumes. Attackers can craft rsync or btrfs receive streams with a symlink such as rootfs pointing to the host root, writing files as root for full host compromise.

items.title: Wasmtime异步回调栈溢出可逃逸沙箱
items.title_zh: Wasmtime异步回调栈溢出可逃逸沙箱
items.summary_zh: 恶意Wasm组件经错误异步回调类型触发栈溢出，可能逃逸沙箱
items.action_zh: 升级Wasmtime至48.0.4/49.0.2或更高
items.repro_note: 需运行恶意Wasm组件，构造异步回调结果类型错配
items.impact_scope: Wasm运行时，宿主进程沙箱边界
items.description: Wasmtime 39.0.0 before 48.0.4 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.2 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability that allows malicious guests to write ~16KB to the native stack via unvalidated async callback result types. Attackers can supply components with mistyped component-model-async callback functions to overwrite return addresses, crashing the host or escaping the sandbox.

items.title: VCO SQL注入可访问内部特权功能
items.title_zh: VCO SQL注入可访问内部特权功能
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可经SQL注入访问内部特权功能，危及VCO机密性完整性可用性
items.action_zh: 升级VCO至厂商修复版本；限制管理面公网暴露
items.repro_note: 需访问VCO管理接口，构造SQL注入参数
items.impact_scope: 本地VCO编排器，管理网络核心
items.description: VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem has a security issue where this issue may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

items.title: Kiloview E3命名参数命令注入
items.title_zh: Kiloview E3命名参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 已认证Web用户经设备命名hostname参数注入命令，以root执行控制设备
items.action_zh: 升级固件；限制管理界面暴露并改强密码
items.repro_note: 登录Web后，在设备命名hostname参数注入shell元字符
items.impact_scope: NDI编码器设备，常暴露管理面
items.description: The system control service on affected Kiloview E3 NDI encoder firmware fails to sanitize the hostname parameter accepted by its device naming endpoint, passing it unquoted into a shell command. An authenticated web user with access to this function can embed characters to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root, resulting in full device compromise.

items.title: 网络设置功能命令注入可root执行
items.title_zh: 网络设置功能命令注入可root执行
items.summary_zh: 具网络配置权限的已认证Web用户可注入系统命令，以root执行
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复版本；限制网络配置权限
items.repro_note: 需登录且具网络配置权限，在相关参数注入命令
items.impact_scope: Web管理设备，需认证配置权限
items.description: The network management service on affected Kiloview E3 NDI encoder firmware fails to validate the network interface name accepted by its link maintenance address configuration endpoint before passing it to a shell command, unlike sibling handlers that perform the same validation. An authenticated web user with permission to configure network settings can exploit this to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root.

items.description: Authentication Bypass by Spoofing vulnerability in Brainstorm Force SureCart surecart allows Authentication Abuse.This issue affects SureCart: from n/a through 4.9.5.

items.title: 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: The network management service on affected Kiloview E3 NDI encoder firmware fails to sanitize one field used when configuring static routes via the web management API. An authenticated web user with permission to configure static routes can exploit this to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root, and the malicious configuration persists across reboots. Successful exploitation could result in full device compromise, including exposure of stored credentials and cryptographic material.
